usedFor: Each new Shopify product is shared by Blog2Social as a link, image or video post on a connected social account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in Blog2Social
bestTemplate.why: Launch posts go out without copying product details by hand, in whichever format suits the account.

watchOut: Blog2Social publishes straight to the connected account, so each post is public the moment “Create Post” runs.
